declare(strict_types=1);
class StrictOption100 {
    public function __toString():string {echo "BAD-CAST;";return "precision";}
    public function __destruct() {
        echo "O:",ini_get("precision"),":",$GLOBALS["row"][0],":",$GLOBALS["leaf"],";";
        $GLOBALS["leaf"]=42;ini_set("precision",21);
    }
}
class StrictValues100 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0;
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$GLOBALS["name"]:$GLOBALS["row"];}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {
        echo "N",$this->pos,";";
        if($this->pos===0){unset($GLOBALS["name"]);}else{$GLOBALS["row"][0]=31;$GLOBALS["leaf"]=17;}
        ++$this->pos;
    }
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
function makeStrict100() {$it=new StrictValues100;$GLOBALS["iterWatch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$name=new StrictOption100;$leaf=7;$row=[3,&$leaf];
$optionWatch=WeakReference::create($name);$iterWatch=null;$result=99;
echo "B;";
try {$result=ini_set(...makeStrict100());echo "BAD-RETURN;";}
catch(TypeError $e) {
    echo "E:",$e->getMessage()==='ini_set(): Argument #1 ($option) must be of type string, StrictOption100 given',":",$result,":",ini_get("precision"),":",$optionWatch->get()!==null,":",$iterWatch->get()===null,":",$row[0],":",$leaf,";";
    $trace=$e->getTrace();$arg0=$trace[0]["args"][0];$arg1=$trace[0]["args"][1];
    echo "A:",$arg0===$optionWatch->get(),":",$arg1[0],":",$arg1[1],";";
    unset($arg0,$arg1,$trace,$e);
    echo "R:",$optionWatch->get()===null,":",ini_get("precision"),":",$leaf,";";
}
ini_restore("precision");echo "Z;";
purpose: Direct strict INI_SET rejects the copied Stringable option after temporary Iterator cleanup, without casting; TypeError TraceArgs keep raw option and copied COW array until catch.
